column2: Through	the	Microsoft	Airband	Initiative,	we’re	working	to	bring	affordable
broadband access to everyone. Here are some highlights from our progress.
Through the new international track of our Airband Initiative, we’ve set a
new goal to extend high-speed internet access to 40 million unserved and
underserved	people	around	the	globe	by	July	2022.
Microsoft	is	expanding	its	work	with	Veterans	Affairs	to	bring	broadband	access,
digital skills training, and telehealth services to veterans living in rural areas.
In partnership with Microsoft, Watch Communications will deploy a variety of
broadband technologies to cover more than four million people in the region,
including 815,000 people in rural areas currently without access to broadband.
